name: natural-5-bullet-cannon-sword-48-start-desktop-1366x768
method: Read-only snapshots plus real DOM mouse and held WASD/Space. Naturally clear waves 1 and 2, choose multishot twice, cease fire to gather 48 enemies. Capture 12 seconds: release a charged sword volley into an open corridor, fire a cannon 25ms later and switch to five-bullet primary 50ms later, then aim into the crowd. No gameplay state, HP, equipment, population or clock injection.
limitations: Windows Chrome headless, 1366×768 at DPR1. No real mobile hardware or human feel evidence.
Frame observer takes one read-only snapshot per rendered frame; observer overhead is included.
48 is the initial hostile count; real attacks and arrivals may vary it during the sample.
observedRetainedEventCounts counts distinct events observed in the bounded retained history as well as the sample; these totals are not presented as sample-only attack counts.
The natural third wave finished at the end of this sample and opened a paused reward overlay. Population fell from 48 to 0; the report does not claim 48 active enemies for all 12 seconds.

screenshots.note: The start image shows the natural 48-enemy population and exercise warning. The end image shows the naturally earned wave-three reward. Mixed projectile coexistence is recorded per frame in allThreeKindsSubset/perFrameCounts.
